svg.title: gqa shapes
svg.text: GQA: 8 KV heads serve 32 query heads
k: [8, T, 64] → k.repeat_interleave(4, dim=0) → [32, T, 64]; the same for v
cached k (or v): [8, T, 64] (each block: one head, [T, 64])
after repeat_interleave(4, dim=0): [32, T, 64], lined up with q's 32 heads
Query heads 4g … 4g+3 all read KV head g. The cache stores only the 8 (4× less memory than 32);
the copies are made on the fly for the matmul. animated: each KV head is copied into its 4 slots
